name: How much does a garage conversion typically cost?

mainEntity.name: How much does a garage conversion typically cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of a garage conversion varies significantly based on factors like size, desired finishes, structural modifications, and the complexity of plumbing or electrical work. Basic conversions might start from around $20,000, while more extensive projects with bathroom additions or significant structural changes can exceed $60,000. It's crucial to obtain a detailed estimate tailored to your specific project. A practical tradeoff to consider is that while higher-end finishes increase upfront costs, they can also contribute to a greater return on investment and enhanced living quality.
acceptedAnswer.description: Garage conversion costs vary widely, typically ranging from $20,000 to over $60,000, depending on size, finishes, and necessary utility work.
